{{Top|leg}}
The '''Barisoni''' were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barison]]. [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] had to rig up a [[Droid caller/Legends|restraining bolt deactivator]] to free his droid [[Vee Gee]] from the Barisoni.
